name: M7.OrbitFibers.action_partition
statement: ∀ (G : Type) [Group G] [Fintype G] (X : Type) [MulAction G X] (c : X), ∀ (P : X → Prop) (test : X → Bool), M7.OrbitFibers.actionCount G c P = M7.OrbitFibers.actionCount G c (fun y => P y ∧ test y = false) + M7.OrbitFibers.actionCount G c (fun y => P y ∧ test y = true)

guidance: Same Boolean partition on actual action records. Count records with multiplicity; do not identify records with orbit points. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
